description: The Tamil Nadu government established a dedicated ministry for Artificial Intelligence, making it the second state, after neighbouring Kerala, to create a separate ministry.
body_lead: 15:38 The Tamil Nadu government established a dedicated ministry for Artificial Intelligence, making it the second state, after neighbouring Kerala, to create a separate ministry. Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam legislator R Kumar, who won from Velachery Assembly constituency, was administered the oath as minister by Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar in Chennai on Thursday in the presence of Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay. He has been allocated Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology and Digital Services portfolios.
